mode.description: Rendering strategy. static = plain HTTP; dynamic = browser render; stealthy = anti-bot oriented browser mode.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier to reuse cookies/browser state across calls.

wait_for.description: Optional readiness hint for dynamic mode, e.g. network_idle or a CSS selector.

max_chars.description: Max characters to return to the agent.

allowed_domains.description: Optional per-call domain allowlist (host or registrable domain).
